paper_text:
VELAMMAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING
END SEMESTER DEGREE EXAMINATIONS
EC8691 - MICROPROCESSORS AND MICROCONTROLLERS
Time: 3 Hours                                                     Max Marks: 50

PART A - (5 x 4 = 20 Marks)
1. Describe the flag register architecture of the 8086 microprocessor. [4 Marks]
2. Differentiate between Memory-Mapped I/O and Peripheral I/O schemes. [4 Marks]
3. Explain the internal RAM memory organization of the 8051 microcontroller. [4 Marks]
4. Describe the operating modes of the 8255 Programmable Peripheral Interface (PPI). [4 Marks]
5. Explain interrupt vector tables and the priority order of hardware interrupts in 8086. [4 Marks]

PART B - (2 x 15 = 30 Marks)
6. (a) Interface a 4x4 matrix keyboard and a 16x2 LCD display to the 8051 microcontroller. Write an assembly/C program to read key presses and display the corresponding character. [15 Marks]
7. (a) Design an 8086-based stepper motor speed control system using the 8254 Programmable Interval Timer and 8259 Interrupt Controller. [15 Marks]
